environment: Isolated HOME, profile and Agent homes; unpackaged Electron; coexistence mode only.
limitations: Replacement mode, signed launchd recovery and real system preference restoration are not covered by this E2E.
probeLimitations: Recovery probes do not mutate real macOS Dock preferences or register background services.
The cross-service restore race uses mocked Mach admission and applies to distinct installed stable and Cloud Dev recovery services; it is not a reproduced same-service restart race.
Widget and shortcut probes use production modules with isolated ports, not full Electron end-to-end coverage.
